method: external-source-only format-aware weighted trimmed consensus used as the Arsenal model prior

format_policy.note: A PPR-only source is never relabeled as Half-PPR or Standard for RB, WR, or TE. Reception-invariant positions may reuse the same total across formats.

direct_inputs: Sleeper depth-chart order when coverage is thin or disagreement is high
context_policy.note: Age and experience are not independently applied to current-season points because projection sources already price those effects; doing so again would double-count them.
